items.title: Jenna Johnson Admits She Was 'A Little Taken Back' by 'DWTS' Elimination
items.summary:
Jenna Johnson is still in shock after being eliminated from Dancing With the Stars in the semifinals with partner Harry Shum Jr. 

“You know what? It’s very bittersweet,” Johnson, 32, told Us exclusively at the L’Oréal Paris Women of Worth Celebration on Wednesday, November 18. “I think this season — you never know what’s going to happen, I think we’ve seen that from the very beginning. It’s so exciting that it’s so celebrated. Everyone’s getting to watch dance, but you never know what’s going to happen, and so last night, obviously, I think I was just like a little taken back. But I am so incredibly grateful for my relationship and partnership with Harry, and that goes far beyond these just three months of Dancing With the Stars.”

Johnson said she “will cherish” the friendship she built with Shum, 44, “forever” despite their elimination.

“That far outweighs any of the heartache I’m feeling right now of not being in the finals and getting to do a freestyle,” she added.

Harry Shum Jr. Reacts to 'DWTS' Elimination, 'Bullying' Throughout Season 

Johnson and Shum were early frontrunners when season 35 premiered in September, but their DWTS journey was cut short just one week before the finale. After receiving perfect scores for both of their semifinal dances on Tuesday, November 17, the pair were ultimately sent home.

While speaking with Us , Johnson opened up about how Shum reacted in the moment. “He kind of just held me,” she said. “He feels like a brother, like a long lost brother. … He just said to me, like, ‘This is not the last time we will create art together,’ and…

items.title: Influencer Allison Kuch Defends Breastfeeding in the Middle of NYC Marathon
items.summary:
Influencer and podcast host Allison Kuch found plenty to celebrate while running the 2026 New York City marathon, just months after giving birth to her daughter, Pepper .  

Kuch, 31, stopped at Mile 17 of the marathon route earlier this month to breastfeed , which she documented on social media and hoped was “empowering for so many women to see.” 

“It was also empowering for me to achieve something like running a marathon so soon postpartum,” Kuch exclusively told Us. “I have yet to have a full night of sleep to this point. I still trained, I was still able to dedicate time to myself. That was all made possible because of the support I have at home.” 

Kuch and her husband, former NFL player Isaac Rochell , welcomed Pepper in April and also share daughter Scottie , born in December 2023. Together, the couple host the Netflix Original podcast “Couldn’t Agree Less,” with new episodes dropping every Thursday.  

Sam Hartman Explains How He'll Balance NFL ‘Day Job’ With ‘Bachelor’ Duties 

“Like, my husband being able to watch the kids while I go on runs, or meet me if the baby is hungry and she doesn’t want to take a bottle,” Kuch explained. “Getting to that moment [at the marathon], I was like, ‘Wow, this feels so good.’ It took so much work to get there. But I want it to be empowering to other women. You should take time for yourself because it’s important as a mom.” 

Rochell, 31, told Us that welcoming baby Pepper into the fold has resulted in “no free time.” 

“There is zero unscheduled free time,” he said. “We can force free time. We can find help. But you’re not just…
items.t: Influencer Allison Kuch Defends Breastfeeding in the Middle of NYC Marathon

items.title: Why Britney Spears' Biopic Team Is 'Taking Their Time' Adapting Memoir
items.summary:
More than two years after Universal Pictures secured the highly coveted rights to Britney Spears ‘ memoir, The Woman in Me , for a reported eight-figure sum, the film adaptation remains in its early stages.

“Britney’s biopic is still being written, but it’s coming together,” a source exclusively tells Us . “Everything is moving in the right direction.”

Wicked ‘s Jon M. Chu is directing the movie based on Spears’ bestselling 2023 memoir while New Girl creator Elizabeth Meriwether is writing the screenplay and La La Land ‘s Marc Platt is producing. The “Toxic” singer, 44, will have creative input.

“The team behind the film wants to do it justice, so they’re taking their time,” the insider shares. “They know all eyes will be on it when it comes out, so they don’t want to get anything wrong.”

Inside Britney Spears' 'Much Quieter' Life 5 Years After Conservatorship 

In the meantime, Meriwether, 45, has been doing her homework. She told The Hollywood Reporter in August that she has read The Woman in Me “multiple times” — both a physical copy and the audiobook narrated by Michelle Williams , with whom she worked on Hulu’s Dying for Sex .

“That audiobook, if people haven’t listened to it, is one of the best audiobooks that’s ever been made,” Meriwether raved. “Michelle is unbelievable. It’s like a monologue. I told her that her performance of the audiobook broke my heart in so many ways. She’s being true to Britney and also telling a story in the way she’s reading it.”

items.title: Actor Alexander Haskin Dead at 38, Pulled From Water Near Santa Monica Pier
items.summary:

Alexander Haskin  was pronounced dead on Monday, November 16, after Santa Monica Police Department harbor guards responded to a call of a man in the water, Lt. Lewis Gilmour told the Los Angeles Times on Wednesday, November 18. He was 38.

Authorities responded to a report of someone in the ocean at around 4:06 p.m. local time. Haskin was pronounced dead just before 5 p.m.

“The evidence shows the man was alone and did not interact with anyone in the period immediately before the incident,” Gilmour told the newspaper. “Security footage corroborates that finding.”

The L.A. Times and TMZ reported that Haskin’s cause of death has been deferred pending further investigation by the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner’s Office.

“On November 16, 2026, at approximately 4:06 p.m., Santa Monica Police Department (SMPD) Harbor Guards responded to a report of a man in the water near the west end of the Santa Monica Pier,” the Santa Monica PD said in a statement posted via Instagram .

The statement continued, “Harbor Guards conducted an underwater search, located the individual and brought him aboard a lifeguard boat, where CPR began. After being hoisted onto the pier deck, Santa Monica Fire Department paramedics continued lifesaving measures. Despite their efforts, he was pronounced deceased at 4:56 p.m.”

items.title: David Beckham's perfume, Poundland – and a mighty, mighty stink | Arwa Mahdawi
items.summary:
The Beckhams have made an art of monetising their every move. But apparently there are limits to where they’re prepared to sell their wares

Thoughts and half-price prayers with Poundland, please. The discount chain has been on the verge of collapse for a while, and its future looks bleak. Now, to add to the ignominy, David Beckham is kicking it while it’s down.

Not literally, by the way: I suppose I should spell that out since we’re dealing with a litigious billionaire. I did not mean to imply or cause a reasonable person to infer that Sir David is standing on Brixton high street kicking a Poundland. Rather, DB Ventures, the licensor of the David Beckham brand, is causing a bit of a stink about the fact that the football legend’s fragrance range was found on sale in the discount store as well as at other purveyors of budget goods. It is now suing the perfume company, Coty, which it further accuses of under reporting sales, for $41m (£31m).
